prose: Anthropic's examples of teams using Claude Sheets, Whiteboards and connectors: Datadog product managers go from idea to feature brief, PRD and prototype faster; a Gusto legal team member built a tool turning negotiated terms into signature-ready contracts, cutting turnaround from over a week to hours; HubSpot-connected dashboards prep customer calls and draft follow-ups within 30 minutes. Vendor-collected testimonials.
highlights: Datadog: idea to PRD and prototype faster
Gusto legal: contracts from a week to hours
HubSpot live dashboards and follow-up drafts
